title: Cross-region DR rehearsal: progressive snapshot replay, throttled failover ramps, and dynamic circuit-breaker calibration
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Run a scheduled active-passive DR rehearsal that validates progressive snapshot replay for cross-region state (tokens/KV), measures SLO adherence during throttled failover ramps, and tunes circuit-breaker thresholds + load-shedding policies to avoid cascade failures. The goal is to produce an executable runbook, automated validation queries, and tuned fallback parameters suitable for runtime-2.4 rollout.
objective: Demonstrate safe promotion of passive region with minimal client-visible SLO degradation (< 5% p99 latency uplift, error rate < 0.5%), validate backup integrity and partial-restore strategies, and calibrate circuit-breaker & shedding policies to maintain availability under degraded capacity.
scope: This ticket covers the rehearsal orchestration, validation harness for KV and token snapshots, load generation profiles, telemetry collection, and parameter tuning. It excludes changes to customer-facing SLA language or Billing adjustments.
out_of_scope: Private deployment upgrade mechanics, on-prem hardware replacement, postmortem report publication to legal teams (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria: A runbook exists with step-by-step play for progressive snapshot replay and phased traffic rampdown/ramp-up
Automated validation queries confirm KV prefix consistency and tokenstore integrity within 10 minutes of promotion
Observability captures per-route p50/p95/p99 latency and error-rate deltas during the rehearsal and shows <5% p99 uplift for critical read/write paths
Circuit-breaker thresholds adjusted and recorded; new thresholds reduce cascading retries in two independent simulated overload scenarios
A retrospective entry with action items and owners is posted to Confluence and linked in this ticket
runbook_steps: Pre-checks: verify latest cross-region snapshots exist in s3://redwood-backups/<region>/daily/, ensure replication lag < 30s; confirm target passive region nodes are in warm state and tainted for no-production traffic
Stage 0 (quiesce writes): issue 10-minute notice via PagerDuty and Console banners, redirect non-critical background jobs to secondary queue
Stage 1 (partial restore): restore metadata and most-read KV prefixes (session*, model-metadata/*) and run prefix-consistency queries (see test_cases). Timebox to 15m

Stage 2 (circuit calibration ramp): intentionally reduce serving capacity in active region by 30% and apply conservative circuit-breaker thresholds (trips at 7% error or 200ms queue time). Run synthetic client profile 'chat-short' at 50% normal RPS for 10m
Stage 3 (traffic siphon and promotion): shift 40% of production traffic to passive region using weighted routing, monitor per-route SLOs for 20m, then shift to 100% if health checks pass
Stage 4 (validate KV and tokenstore): run reconciliation script that compares snapshot checksums and live reads for 1,000 sampled keys; verify token refreshes succeed for sampled sessions
Stage 5 (rollback/soft-fallback): if p99 latency uplift > 10% or error rate > 1.5% on critical routes, activate automatic fallback to prior region and drain promoted nodes
Post-run: collect traces, export dashboards, runbook checklist completion, create retrospective with timeline and metrics
test_cases: KV prefix consistency: sample 1,000 keys across high-cardinality prefixes and compare checksums between source snapshot and restored set; allow up to 0.2% transient mismatch (eventual consistency window)
Tokenstore validation: rehydrate 500 active sessions from snapshot and perform authenticated request flows, assert successful token refresh and no unauthorized errors

SLO measurement: run synthetic traffic for chat-short, chat-long, and embedding-bulk profiles during ramp phases and compute p50/p95/p99 and error rates; baseline against previous week's production baseline
Circuit-breaker verification: trigger two overload patterns (CPU-bound path and IO-saturated path) and assert breakers trip and recovery window respects configured cooldown
Failback validation: execute a controlled failback and ensure no durable state divergence; log any compensating actions
monitoring_and_alerts: Dashboards: dr/rehearsal/summary (latency by route), dr/rehearsal/kv-integrity, routing-weight-heatmap
Alerts to trigger automated rollback: dr.p99_uplift_pct > 10 for >5m OR dr.error_rate > 1.5% for >5m
Cost telemetry: record token-per-second and estimated token-cost delta during rehearsal for billing analysis
Event tracing: tag rehearsal traces with rehearsal_id and collect top N slow traces for postmortem
rollback_plan: Immediate rollback: weighted routing set to previous region weights within 1 minute via console playbook
State reconciliation: if mismatch detected, keep passive region read-only and schedule full snapshot re-import during maintenance window
Post-rollback diagnostics: run logcollect script and attach to ticket; notify customers if sessions were impacted for >10 minutes
Escalation path: SRE on-call -> Infra lead -> CTO for cross-regional incidents affecting >10% of customers
